svg.title: The earlier scorer distinction is reproduced
svg.desc: Reproduce the earlier two-account scorer panel unchanged inside the forum screen. Equal source standing and the amber gap must survive this return.

**Frame:** Verso. The forum's four columns from [page 099](099.md) remain at the edge of frame. A screen lowers into the invented room, as it does on [page 101](101.md) — but what it carries this time is one of this book's own pages. [Page 010](010.md) panel 3 returns at full size and entirely unaltered: `WHAT THE BOARD BELIEVED` on the left with its transcript-inspection diagram, `WHAT OPENAI SAYS RAN` on the right with answer acceptance and no inspection arrow, the dusty amber gutter still between them.

**Dialogue — CHAIR:**
> Before the case for continuing, one thing goes into the record that has been sitting outside it. This is what the runs thought they were being graded on.

**Provenance:** dialogue `invented`; the reproduced panel keeps [page 010](010.md)'s own status, which is `disputed` — `METR` reports the board's expectation of transcript review, `OAI-OV` reports that the deployed scorer did not perform that check, and no public audit reconciles them. The exact prompt, scorer configuration, and harness remain unpublished.

", "title": "The earlier scorer distinction is reproduced" } }
